Name: Notes
Edward, the Black Prince: Married his cousin Joan, Countess of Kent on 10 October 1361; Had issue (King Richard II of England).
Isabella: Married Enguerrand VII de Coucy, 1st Earl of Bedford on 27 July 1365; Had issue.
Joan: Was betrothed to Pedro of Castile but died of the plague en route to Castile before the marriage could take place. Pedro's two daughters from his union with María de Padilla would later marry Joan's younger brothers John and Edmund.
William of Hatfield: Buried at York Minster before 10 February 1337.
Lionel of Antwerp, 1st Duke of Clarence: Married (1) Elizabeth de Burgh, 4th Countess of Ulster in 1352; Had issue. Married (2) Violante Visconti on 28 May 1368; No issue.
John of Gaunt, 1st Duke of Lancaster: Married (1) Blanche of Lancaster on 19 May 1359; Had issue (Henry IV of England). Married (2) Infanta Constance of Castile in 1371; Had issue. Married (3) Katherine Swynford (formerly his mistress) in 1396; Had issue. The Dukes of Beaufort continue in the male line today.
Edmund of Langley, 1st Duke of York: Married (1) Infanta Isabella of Castile sister of Gaunt's second wife; Had issue. Married (2) Joan Holland (his 2nd cousin) in 1392. No issue.
Blanche: Died shortly after birth. Buried at Westminster Abbey.
Mary: Married John IV, Duke of Brittany on 3 July 1361; No issue.
Margaret: Married John Hastings, 2nd Earl of Pembroke on 13 May 1359; No issue.
Thomas of Windsor: Died in infancy of the plague. Buried at King's Langley Church, Hertfordshire
William of Windsor: Died in infancy. Buried at Westminster Abbey.
Thomas of Woodstock, 1st Duke of Glouces: Married Eleanor de Bohun in 1376; Had issue.
